comparison.objective: Fit LPG and natural-gas detectors at gas-appropriate low and high locations; candidate finishes four installed HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic selection and height-constrained detector placement versus recessed precision tool alignment, bimanual hammering, fracture control, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Place each detector beside the matching appliance at the appropriate height versus four physical tang fractures with complete containment and zero component damage.
comparison.reason: Installation is generic to both, but the record tests gas-property reasoning and placement rather than insert-finishing mechanics. No spec versions or exact height thresholds are available.
